scripts.build:helper: cd live-helper && swift build -c release && codesign --force --sign "Developer ID Application" --options runtime --entitlements ../build/entitlements.mac.inherit.plist --timestamp .build/release/unlimeety-live
scripts.build:runner: node local-llm/fetch-runner.mjs && codesign --force --sign "Developer ID Application" --options runtime --entitlements build/entitlements.mac.inherit.plist --timestamp local-llm/bin/*
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:runner && npm run build:helper && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.build:mac:arm64: npm run build:runner && npm run build:helper && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.notarize:dmg: codesign --force --sign "Developer ID Application" --timestamp dist/Unlimeety-arm64.dmg && xcrun notarytool submit dist/Unlimeety-arm64.dmg --keychain-profile "$APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE" --wait && xcrun stapler staple dist/Unlimeety-arm64.dmg
scripts.build:all: npm run build:runner && npm run build:helper && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --win --linux
